archetypes.name: brainstorm-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 1d.5 now owns multiple resume-sensitive side effects.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 1d.5 entry, collect, and complete paths for resume safety and single-ingestion behavior. Check skipped, already-done, collector-failure, launch-failure, and dirty-tree branches against the prompt contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

Pay special attention to suppression semantics, first-command detection, and the decision not to scan scripts/*.md. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
